description: This file defines the OceanTheme class, which provides a custom theming configuration for a Flutter application. It includes color constants, ThemeData settings, gradient backgrounds, and shadow styles, tailored to create a cohesive visual theme.

classes.name: OceanTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing a custom Ocean-themed configuration for Flutter apps, including color schemes, theme data, background gradients, and shadow styles.

methods.name: themeData
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured with the Ocean theme colors, styles, and platform-specific page transition animations.

methods.name: gradientBackground
methods.description: Creates a BoxDecoration with a linear gradient matching the Ocean theme colors for subtle background effects.

methods.name: softShadows
methods.description: Provides a list of BoxShadow objects used to add subtle depth to UI components like cards and tiles.
